University Student Grade Calculator using Nested Class

Problem Statement:
Write a program demonstrating nested classes where a University class contains a nested Student class that computes grade.

Description:
The nested class should:

Store name and marks

Compute grade (A/B/C)

Demonstrate interaction between outer and inner class

Grade Criteria:
Marks ≥ 80 → A
Marks ≥ 60 → B
Else → C

Input Format:
Name Marks

Output Format:
Grade
